{{Top|leg}}
'''Kollan''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kollan relayed information about [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] and [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] efforts to regulate the sale and use of [[Lowickan Firegem]]s.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
